question.text: Cerium $(Z=58)$ is an important member of the lanthanoids. Which of the following statements about cerium is incorrect?

options.text: The common oxidation states of cerium are $+3$ and $+4$
Cerium (IV) acts as an oxidizing agent
The $+4$ oxidation state of cerium is not known in solutions
The $+3$ oxidation state of cerium is more stable than the $+4$ oxidation state

solution.text: Oxidation potential of $\mathrm{Ce}(\mathrm{IV})$ in aqueous solution is supposed to be $-$ ve i.e. $-0.784 \mathrm{~V}$ at $25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$
